page.overview:
What is The Interdimensional Rift?

The Interdimensional Rift is a "place beyond space and time" in Final Fantasy XVI related to the heart of Drake's Spine and the Ultima that is the true form for this Mothercrystal. The Interdimensional Rift is a dark void full of structures floating in mid-air, and no apparent end to the landscape or an entrance. Humanoid statues appear fused into the floating structures. It is an unrevisitable location.

The rift looks different from the "pocket dimensions" other Ultimas of their collective had pulled Clive Rosfield into before, such as before Typhon the Transgressor at Drake's Head, in that the Interdimensional Rift has matter floating about, and is shrouded in darkness. The in-game lore implies that the rift exists inside Ultima's mind and was created by Ultima.

Interdimensional Rift is a recurring name in the Final Fantasy series for a location lodged from geographical continuity of the world. It first appeared in Final Fantasy V.

Clive and Joshua Rosfield made their way to the last Mothercrystal on the Twins, Drake's Spine in Stonhyrr, the capital of Waloed. The bridge to the Mothercrystal was guarded by an army of Akashic, as the entire nation of Waloed had turned as a result of Ultima's Primogenesis. Jill Warrick, Dion Lesage, and other Cursebreakers arrived to aid them on Midadol Telamon's ship, the Enterprise, and were to hold down the army while Clive and Joshua continued on. Before the brothers could set foot into the Mothercrystal, they were pulled into a void and disappeared, their loyal frost wolf, Torgal, leaping into the void after them.
